authentication.description: Choose how visitors identify themselves before viewing content.

authentication.passwordReplacePlaceholder: Enter a new password to replace

allowedViewers.title: Allowed viewers
allowedViewers.hint: Add full email addresses separated by commas

blockedViewers.title: Blocked viewers
blockedViewers.roomHint: Blocked for every share link in this deal room

additionalProtections.description: Reduce leakage risk with watermarks, NDA gates, and download controls.

management.questionsDescription: Reply to visitor Ask questions from this link. This is not the Signal inbox.
management.aiRefusedHint: AI could not answer from authorized materials. The visitor may escalate to you.
management.repeatPinSuggest: Asked {{count}} times — consider pinning as FAQ to reduce repeat load.

management.askPolicyModeSupervisedHint: AI answers first; sensitive or refused questions escalate to you.

management.askPolicyModeFormalHint: All questions go to a formal review queue. Approved answers can be scheduled and published anonymously.
management.askPolicyModeUpdateFailed: Failed to update Ask routing mode
